items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: I want to mention the fact that Jimmy Blanton had joined the band. In '37.

ctx.x: A great musician. So, we made our theme song, 'Lazy Rhythm,' and we made 'I Like Pie, I Like Cake.' On the opposite side. Jimmy Blanton had a solo; he had a eight-bar solo, I think it was, a little interlude, you remember?
